title: Docs pages join the app shell on desktop: one appearance, no top bar, both entry points and every old docs link kept (#36107 item 11)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Filing gate ③ — maintainer-dispatched epic work, ruled. Source: topic #36107. The maintainer, verbatim, in seat repo:objectstack#4's session: 「#36062、#36107：后续拆卡继续」. Split summary: #36107 comment 7146718835.

**Ruling (record 7142354097 on #36107), verbatim:** 「「文档页并入应用外壳」（#36107 第三阶段 F A（推荐）：统一成一种外观，两个入口和旧链接都保留。」
Meaning, as recorded: docs render in ONE appearance (inside the app shell); both entry points stay; every existing docs link keeps resolving to the same shell page; closed #35424 is voided only in its "with the top bar" clause.

**Business reason.** Every other desktop page lost the top bar in phase 1 (#36112); docs pages are the one place that still draws it, and the standalone `/docs` portal draws a third look. A reader moving between an app and its manual meets two different shells; the epic's direction (「Studio、设置、文档这些页面，一起改。」, board figure 6) is one shell.

**Where it lives (read at `origin/main` 2af97295).**
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx:197-290` — `isAppDocsPath` keeps the top bar on an app's docs pages at every width, citing #35424.
- `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:203-222` — `/docs` renders inside `DefaultHomeLayout` (with `AppHeader`), not the app shell.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/consoleRoutePaths.ts` — the docs path predicates.

**Change.**
1. An app's docs pages (`/apps/:packageId/docs…`) draw in the app shell like every other desktop page: no top bar, the persistent sidebar, the page header's action group.
2. The standalone docs entry (`/docs`) renders the same appearance — the shell's sidebar carries the docs navigation, 「全部文档」 (All docs) first — instead of `DefaultHomeLayout`.
3. Both entry points stay, and every existing docs URL keeps resolving to the same page in the shell (pin the old URL forms).
4. Phone unchanged.

**Acceptance.** At desktop width, an app's docs page and `/docs` show no top bar, the same sidebar and header as an app page; every docs URL that resolved before resolves to the same content; the #35424 behaviour other than the top bar is unchanged; phone unchanged. Tests pin the route exception's removal and the old URL forms; browser screenshots of both entries.

Grade: area:ux · Task · the last desktop surface off the shell, met on every docs visit · p2 (epic grade). Size M.
Reader: zone a4-C of seat repo:objectstack#4 dispatches it to an `os-dev` after #37149.
Dedupe: `docs page app shell top bar` (objectstack, open) → 8 hits, none about this (seat posts, #36737, #35445, #31908, #34571, #36107); `文档页 外壳` → 1 (#36107 itself).
